reviews.title: A Tier rated PSU on the SPL charts at a great price.
reviews.comment:
Pros,
1.  It's a 1200w 80+ Gold power of course.
2. It has the new ATX 3.1 and PCIE 3.1 standard.
3. It has the new 12v 2x6 connector fir the newest GPUs(especially from Nvidia).
4. Has pretty of connections for most PC components.
5. The fan isn't too loud and it's  surprisingly  cool(see cons).
6. It has an Eco switch(though I don't use it).
7. This PSU will handle a GPU like an RTX 5090. I'm currently running a RTX 5090 with no issue at the moment(only time will tell).
8. It's a sturdy PSU, yet smaller in size. This made routing the cables so much easier.
9. Lastly the price. For what you get and tge quality this would be extremely hard to beat even if it's competition was running a sale. It's not impossible to beat because some may need some better and/or different where the price isn't justified.
Cons,
1. The intake area isn't the most ventilated. I'm actually surprised it stays as cool as it does. Perhaps because I'm not majorly pushing my PC's power limit.
2. The fan could be a little better, but it seems to do the job.
3. I wish some of the cables were braided rather than using flat plastic coated wire. The coated wire maybe easier to route, but I'm skeptical of it's durability and I was cautious when installing this PSU because of this.
4. If your PC is running something like a RTX 5090(especially with a last generation Intel I7s or I9s) I'd advise undervolting your GPU. I will put less risk on your 12v cable, reduce any coil whine and possibly make PSU and other components last longer.
reviews.author: Steven Tarren

reviews.title: Top notch quality PSU for the price!
reviews.comment: Montech is a brand I've grown to trust highly, and this PSU is no exception.  This first caught my attention because of the excellent price.  I then researched and found it also got exceptional marks for performance/durability on the Cultists PSU tier list with an A rating which is something I always verify before committing to buying a PSU.  It's extremely quiet, connects easily.  The black cables make everything look sleek.  The only thing I would like to see improved is for the PCIe cables to be another inch or two longer to allow cable runs for different paths in a case a little easier.  That's minor though, and it didn't stop anything from working as intended.  Top notch quality PSU for the price!

reviews.title: Excellent quality at an affordable price.
reviews.comment:
Bought this after reading the review for it on Tom's Hardware. So far working very well.
In spite of being a 1200W PSU, it is significantly smaller (140mm length) than my previous EVGA 750 G2 (180mm length), which barely fit in my case.
Construction quality looks excellent; the aesthetics is very pleasing and the casing is thick and sturdy.
Note that even though it is rated at 80+ Gold, it's actual performance far exceeds that standard (closer to Platinum). Check Tom's for details.
